stories.title: RBI forms technical consultative committee to review market infrastructure
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has created a technical consultative committee that includes seven external members from banks and other financial institutions. The committee will engage with market participants to examine the functioning and efficiency of money and related derivative markets, and to assess both domestic and international developments that affect market infrastructure.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Super Micro stock soars: AI server boom drives record earnings
stories.summary: (Sources: Reuters, Quartz, KuCoin) Super Micro reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $19.95 billion, compared with $5.02 billion a year earlier. Super Micro forecasts second-quarter revenue of $19.5 billion to $21.5 billion, exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $17.14 billion, according to Reuters.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
stories.summary: In particular, the company is finally disclosing more about the economics of compute, and how much of Anthropic’s skyrocketing revenue is being lost to compute costs. Broadly, Anthropic had a good quarter: revenue reached $17 billion, up from $11.5 billion in the previous quarter, suggesting durable growth.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
